findings.codeql_raw_query:
/**
 * @name Trace flow to eval in distn_infrastructure
 * @description Traces flow from function parameters to eval in scipy/stats/_distn_infrastructure.py
 * @kind path-problem
 * @problem.severity error
 * @id py/scipy-stats-eval-trace
 * @tags security
 *       external/cwe/cwe-095
 */

import python
import semmle.python.dataflow.new.DataFlow
import semmle.python.dataflow.new.TaintTracking
import semmle.python.Concepts

module EvalConfig implements DataFlow::ConfigSig {
  predicate isSource(DataFlow::Node source) {
    source instanceof DataFlow::ParameterNode
  }

  predicate isSink(DataFlow::Node sink) {
    exists(Call call |
      call.getFunc().(Name).getId() = "eval" or
      call.getFunc().(Name).getId() = "exec" |
      sink.asExpr() = call.getArg(0)
    )
    and sink.getLocation().getFile().getShortName() = "_distn_infrastructure.py"
  }
}

module EvalFlow = TaintTracking::Global<EvalConfig>;
import EvalFlow::PathGraph

from EvalFlow::PathNode source, EvalFlow::PathNode sink
where EvalFlow::flowPath(source, sink)
select sink.getNode(), source, sink, "Code injection in stats infrastructure from parameter $@.", source.getNode(), source.getNode().toString()
findings.hypothesis: User input flowing into eval() in scipy/stats/_distn_infrastructure.py causes code execution.

message.text: Code injection in stats infrastructure from parameter [\[summary param\] position 0 in builtins.dict](1).
Code injection in stats infrastructure from parameter [ControlFlowNode for .0](1).
